newsitem.title: USA: Colombia wants to probe Coporo potential further.
newsitem.headline: Colombia wants to probe Coporo potential further.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol wants to probe further the potential of the Coporo prospect despite disppointing first tests, Mines and Energy Minister Rodrigo Villamizar said on Thursday.
"It's very costly and very complex but we cannot stop," he told Reuters.
"The first drill didn't work. But we've collected some very interesting information," he said. "We think we need two more drillings before we know the potential."
Villamizar said Malaysia's Petronas and a Canadian company, which he did not name, had expressed interest in buying geological information on Coporo or continuing the drilling.
The government had touted Coporo as Colombia's next giant field. But the first exploration found it was not commercially viable and work had halted.
